description: This file is a shell script that manages the lifecycle of an FTP server service, including initialization, start, stop, and handling LAN/WAN status changes.

methods.name: service_init
methods.description: Initializes the service by obtaining the current LAN IP address.

methods.name: service_start
methods.description: Starts the FTP daemon and ensures the directory exists with proper permissions.

methods.name: service_lanwan_status
methods.description: Checks LAN and WAN status and starts or stops the FTP service accordingly.
